biggest_catch: Zero guaranteed work: Voice123 says you set your own rates and keep 100% of earnings, but every booking comes from winning auditions against a large talent pool; the free Standard membership gets limited invitations, and paid Pro tiers ($495/$888 on the official plans page) gate the larger shares of matching projects.
catches: No guaranteed volume — you must audition for posted projects and compete with other voice actors; nothing on the official pages promises bookings.
Pay ranges are category/usage-dependent; the headline figures ($400–$5,000 for commercials) are top-end ranges, not expected per-project pay.
Free Standard membership exists, but paid Pro tiers gate access to larger shares of matching projects ($495 → 50% of matching projects, $888 → 65%, higher tier → 80%).
You need your own recording setup and demos to win work; the quoted ranges include no allowance for equipment or editing costs.

c1.evidence: Voice123 — real operating voice-over marketplace; official talent FAQ (voice123.com/talent) and official Booth rate article.

c2.evidence: Official talent FAQ: 'New voice actors might start with $100–$500 per project.' Official Booth rate article: commercials $400–$5,000, audiobooks $200–$300/hr, video games $200–$350/hr, e-learning $100–$300/finished hour, film/animation $500–$2,000/session, narration $500–$1,500/hr.

c3.evidence: Official: 'Keep 100% of your earnings – zero deductions.' Free Standard membership exists. No platform cut on talent earnings.

c4.evidence: Official plans page: 23,000 projects posted in the prior 12 months with an average project budget of $350; secure payment via the platform. Exact per-project payout timing not published on the reviewed pages.

eligibility: Open sign-up; free Standard membership. Paid Pro tiers unlock larger shares of matching project invitations. Talent sets their own rates and must win auditions.

steps: Go to https://voice123.com/talent and create a free Standard talent profile.
Record and upload your voice demos (commercial, narration, etc.) and complete your profile.
Set your own rates — Voice123's official guidance says new actors might start at $100–$500 per project.
Audition for posted projects matching your profile; the official plans page reports 23,000 projects posted in the prior 12 months at a $350 average budget.
Deliver approved work and get paid per project — Voice123 takes zero deductions from talent earnings.
